CMAKE_MINIMUM_REQUIRED(VERSION 3.26.0...4.3.0)
# Copyright © from 2022 to present, UNKNOWN STRYKER. All Rights Reserved.
PROJECT(stb
        VERSION 0.0
        DESCRIPTION "stb image loader"
        LANGUAGES C)

GET_FILENAME_COMPONENT(STB_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR} ABSOLUTE)
INCLUDE("${STB_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../CMake/predefined-settings.cmake")
INCLUDE("${STB_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../CMake/frogman-engine.cmake")

INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES(${STB_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR})
FILE(GLOB STB "${STB_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/*.h" "${STB_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/*.c")




ADD_LIBRARY(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} STATIC ${STB})




IF(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Windows" AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR STREQUAL "x64")
    IF(SIMD STREQUAL AVX512F)
        SET_TARGET_PROPERTIES(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES
        ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_DEBUG          ${STB_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/X86-64/Windows/AVX512F/Debug
        ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELWITHDEBINFO ${STB_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/X86-64/Windows/AVX512F/RelWithDebInfo
        ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELEASE        ${STB_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/X86-64/Windows/AVX512F/Release
        ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_MINSIZEREL     ${STB_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/X86-64/Windows/AVX512F/MinSizeRel
        )
    ELSE()
        SET_TARGET_PROPERTIES(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES
        ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_DEBUG          ${STB_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/X86-64/Windows/AVX-SSE2/Debug
        ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELWITHDEBINFO ${STB_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/X86-64/Windows/AVX-SSE2/RelWithDebInfo
        ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELEASE        ${STB_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/X86-64/Windows/AVX-SSE2/Release
        ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_MINSIZEREL     ${STB_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/X86-64/Windows/AVX-SSE2/MinSizeRel
        )
    ENDIF()

ELSEIF(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Windows" AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR STREQUAL "ARM64")
SET_TARGET_PROPERTIES(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES
ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_DEBUG          ${STB_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/ARM64/Windows/Debug
ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELWITHDEBINFO ${STB_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/ARM64/Windows/RelWithDebInfo
ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELEASE        ${STB_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/ARM64/Windows/Release
ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_MINSIZEREL     ${STB_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/ARM64/Windows/MinSizeRel
)

ELSEIF(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux" AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR STREQUAL "x64")
SET_TARGET_PROPERTIES(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES
ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_DEBUG          ${STB_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/X86-64/Linux/Debug
ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELWITHDEBINFO ${STB_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/X86-64/Linux/RelWithDebInfo
ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELEASE        ${STB_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/X86-64/Linux/Release
ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_MINSIZEREL     ${STB_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/X86-64/Linux/MinSizeRel
)

ELSEIF(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux" AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR STREQUAL "ARM64")
SET_TARGET_PROPERTIES(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES
ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_DEBUG          ${STB_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/ARM64/Linux/Debug
ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELWITHDEBINFO ${STB_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/ARM64/Linux/RelWithDebInfo
ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELEASE        ${STB_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/ARM64/Linux/Release
ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_MINSIZEREL     ${STB_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/ARM64/Linux/MinSizeRel
)

ELSE()
    MESSAGE(FATAL_ERROR "System not selected.")

ENDIF()
